failing_case: spec-step-on case: case.yaml loads plugins/openspec, scaffold.sh writes `[specs] method = "openspec"`, and prompt.md

one gets it only from the hook). If SessionStart's additionalContext never reached the session, the case would still

the rule the way a real session does (hook only), or the eval says it measures something else.
